strips.title: A shedding week with Noeul — how the fur actually gets handled

panels.head: Monday — the couch, again
panels.text: A 23 kg Jindo blows his coat twice a year. The sofa is beige. The dog is not.

panels.head: Tuesday — thirty seconds
panels.text: Short strokes at 45 degrees. The chamber fills, press the button, dump the wad. No refills.

panels.head: Saturday — brush day
panels.text: The grooming vacuum takes fur off the dog before it reaches the couch. Eco mode, treats, ten minutes.

panels.head: Sunday — guests
panels.text: One pass on the cushions, one on the car seat. Nobody mentions dog hair.

strips.title: The robot litter box, week one — what cat owners describe

panels.head: Day 1 — set up in minutes
panels.text: Old box beside it, Wi-Fi on, app open. Fill to the line, not over it — the classic rookie mistake.

panels.head: Day 3 — first visit
panels.text: Most cats walk in within days. The globe turns after they leave; clumps drop into the sealed drawer.

panels.head: Night — about 37 dB
panels.text: Roughly a whisper. The night light is on; nobody wakes up.

panels.head: Vacation — the app knows
panels.text: Drawer and litter levels on your phone. The sitter comes when it says so, not every day.
